reviews.title: Careful giving money to sleeper, you may never get it back
reviews.text:
DO NOT trust Sleeper Safe with real money
Ran a $25 cash league with 9 friends. We cancelled, I hit "refund" for everyone in the app — and not a single person actually got their money back. Sleeper Safe quietly traps funds inside the app instead of sending them back to your card or bank, no warning, no disclosure. It's been 9 days and support still hasn't fixed even MY refund. Now they're telling my friends each of them has to individually sit in a support queue to maybe get their $25 back — after the app already told us it was refunded. This is a broken, dishonest system for something that's supposed to handle people's actual money. If you're pooling cash for a league, know you might not see it again without a fight. Avoid Sleeper Safe entirely.

reviews.title: Growing concerns
reviews.text:
Over the last 18 months, the app has become dramatically less user friendly. 

Commercialization has changed the foundation of the app, with betting being extremely pushed. There are constant advertisements that didn't use to exist that must be dealt with before users can continue to their dashboard.

The functionality of the app continues to weaken, with a growing number of bugs that cause the app to crash outright, or cause the user to repeat processes. For instance, I've updated the app more times than I can remember over the last 6 months, but a trade bug still persists. 

If a user looks at a player profile while in a trade, and then backs out, it can completely clear the trade and take you back to your league dashboard, causing several steps to be necessary to recreate work in trades. 

... And now there are in app notifications that are completely unnecessary, not useful because they don't provide a link to fixing the problem... which means the old notification system was just fine.... and I can't turn them off. 

When I first began using the sleeper app in 2022, I couldn't stop telling everyone that I knew who wasn't using it because it was that far ahead of everyone else. Unfortunately it has settled into mediocrity, with no meaningful tools being introduced to fantasy players since at least that time.

It's enough now that I'm interested in seeing what else is out there for the first time since I became a member, something I was almost certain I wouldn't be saying a

reviews.title: Messed Up Draft UI Panel
reviews.text: The player panel in drafts used to be perfect. You could drag it to take up exactly 50% of the screen so you could keep a close eye on both player lists and the draft board, perfect for fast drafts where you need to pay attention to both simultaneously and quickly. Then earlier this year there was suddenly an update whereby the player panel could only be stuck to certain places: covering the entire screen (can’t see draft board), covering 75% of the screen (can only see a couple rounds on draft board, not useful enough), covering 25% of the screen (now can only see three players at a time, not useful), and covering none of the screen. 75% and 25% size are much less than ideal, and I wish they would bring back the 50% player panel coverage to make fast drafts more enjoyable.

reviews.title: Scammy withdrawal practices
reviews.text:
Just know that if you deposit, regardless of play through, your money is locked on their app at least 3 days. Completely defies the industry standard where same day deposits and withdrawals are the norm. My guess is that they like locking funds up because it persuades people to continue playing on their platform after a win. It also defies any sort of responsible gambling initiatives because it incentivizes play even if you don’t want to, the money is right there in the app! Just submit another lineup!

I cannot recommend an app that has these standards in 2026. There are some nice features and promos here and there but the promos usually have extremely low limits ($10 standard, $50 if you are lucky). You can get the same or better experience on a fantasy pick em app like underdog or chalkboard and you know that you always have access to your money. 

This type of behavior is reminiscent of the shady off shore sportsbooks of the early 2000s where you had ridiculous play through requirements for bonuses. That said at least you had a path to getting your money in those situations. Sleeper just draws the line in the sand at 3 days and acts like that is normal.

reviews.title: Unacceptable
reviews.text:
I had a winning sports betting ticket on Sleeper, but when it came time to withdraw my money, the app would not let me cash out. I contacted support and was specifically told my withdrawal would be available on May 28th. The 28th came, and I still could not access my winnings.

At this point, it feels extremely misleading and unprofessional. If users win fairly and follow the rules, there should not be excuses or delays when it’s time to pay out. The lack of transparency and broken promises from support make it hard to trust this platform with real money.

I understand apps can have verification or processing delays, but giving customers a specific date and then still not resolving the issue is unacceptable. Right now, it honestly feels like my money is being held unfairly, and that raises serious concerns about how Sleeper handles payouts and customer trust.
